text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I came with Satono Diamond
to watch Kitasan Black run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, Kita-chan and the others are coming out!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Kita-chan, are you feeling a bit down...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Is she nervous, I wonder...?
...Maybe it's because she isn't running?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature stepped smoothly out from the crowd. Apparently, she was one of the upperclassmen who threw a welcome party for Satono Diamond and her peers when they first enrolled.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! That's right, she won the
Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep. She's not running today.
Kitasan seemed so fired up to beat her
in the Kikuka Sho, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Not only is there no real competition...
It also feels like there's no main character around, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: To think there's no clear favorite...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chaaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan is super focused...
Looks like my worries were for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure she'll show us a run
worthy of today's star!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's a festival! Yodo is a festival! It's a Kitasan Festival!
Claiming victory in the Kikuka Sho is Kitasan Black—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! As expected of Kita-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No way. Kitasan was also
one of the super sparkly bunch...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Still... Kita-chan looked like she was struggling a bit with her positioning near the end...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...In my case, it'll come down to a late-stretch duel.
So to avoid getting boxed in on the inside,
I'll swing wide around the 4th corner, and after that...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
......Seriously?
Whoa~, this side is way too blinding too~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the day after returning from watching the Kikuka Sho—
choice_data_list: That's the end of today's menu!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I can still keep going!
I'm worried about my stamina...
So please give me extra training menu items!!
choice_data_list: Now isn't the time to be building stamina.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Then how about hill sprints!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond pleaded passionately.
However, since she was still in the Junior Class,
I wanted to hold off on high-strain training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain that putting a heavy load on a body
that hasn't fully matured yet could lead to injuries.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right. I'm sorry...
I guess seeing Kita-chan in the Kikuka Sho got me all worked up, and I got ahead of myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she was inspired by yesterday's race.
She appears to have more motivation than she knows what to do with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then, if we can find a way to let her channel her motivation
without putting a strain on her body—"
choice_data_list: How about special training to break the academy's jinx?
How about some special training to break the academy's jinx?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll do it!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Let us proceed at once!
Where is this jinx?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They jumped at the idea with incredible enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now, what's the first jinx?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Academy Jinx #1: "If you win a Menko match on the rooftop,
you'll slip on the stairs on the way down."
Just as we took out the Menko cards—
Oh, hey, it's Satono and Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"What's going on? If you're playing menko, count us in!
We were just looking for something to do!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who called out was Mejiro Palmer.
Ikuno Dictus and Nice Nature were with her as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If you'd be my partner, by all means!
To tell you the truth, I'm currently undergoing
special training to break a jinx!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Special training to break a jinx?
What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's the reason.
In that case, we'll help out too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. If it's about the academy's jinxes,
I happen to know about ten of them myself.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The jinx here is: 'If you play a Menko match on the roof
and win, you'll slip on the stairs on the way back.'

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If Satono-san wins the menko match
and makes it down the stairs safely on the way back,
I believe that would break the jinx.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Nature, you were really good at menko, right!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't say it's my forte... though I do play it a lot.
So, are you good at Menko, Satono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I haven't done it much, but I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like it's gonna be tough just beating Nature first.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —And we're here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ooh~! Made it down the stairs without falling!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehe! First jinx, broken!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A school store superstition: 'If you buy the very last
bottle of juice, you'll have bad luck all day.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, this happens to be the very last one.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As for whether we are unlucky or not...
Let Satono-san and me draw lots to find out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
――Ikuno got 4th prize, and Satono got 1st.
Man, talk about lucky.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The second jinx has been broken!
We did it~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —That makes ten! Jinx-breaking streak of ten accomplished!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Breaking ten whole jinxes...
You're amazing, Satono... I really look up to you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No. Not running away from the jinx, nor your family's dream... Satono, you're truly admirable for facing it all head-on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're a bit like McQueen in that respect.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Really!? I'm so glad!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I... look up to McQueen-san
so very much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Your stoic dedication toward your goals,
and your dignified poise under pressure,
are what I aspire to achieve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Just like McQueen-san, who bore the hopes of the Mejiro family and made them a reality, I want to fulfill the Satono family's long-cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, McQueen also praised
Satono for working so hard
toward her family's dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm nowhere near that good.
I haven't achieved any noteworthy results yet.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...It seems... being a sparkling Umamusume comes with its own sparkling share of hardships...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: We're rooting for you too, you know! Go for it, Satono! Don't lose!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!
